statement: There are constants C, c > 0 with the following property. Let V be a normal projective canonical fourfold with KV ∼Q 0, and let a finite group G act on V. Suppose that every G-equivariant rational fibration with geometrically integral generic fibre and with both base and fibre of positive dimension has geometric generic fibre of general type on a smooth projective resolution. It is enough to impose this condition on the rational quotients supplied by Lemma 5.1. If P is an ample rational Cartier divisor satisfying g∗P ∼Q P for every g ∈ G, then γ(P; V) ≤ C(P4 )1/4 , ε(P; x) ≥ c(P4 )1/4 (6.1) at a very general smooth point x ∈ V, where ε(P; x) = inf x∈D⊂V D an integral curve P · D multx D . The constants are independent of V, G, and P.
